usage: Usually refers to the flower/plant orchid as a general noun. It is a common, everyday word in Hong Kong Cantonese.
Can be used on its own or with other plant words, e.g. in garden, flower-shop, or home-decor contexts. The tone is neutral and natural.
Often appears in topic-based vocabulary about plants, flowers, gardening, and gifting. It is not a slang word or a technical botanical term.
For learners, treat 蘭花 as a simple countable noun in ordinary speech; in writing, it can also appear in more formal or descriptive contexts.
